headline: 15 Michigan deals, $1.4B raised — led by Mercedes-Benz Financial Services USA LLC

top_deals.summary: Mercedes-Benz Financial Services USA LLC, a Farmington Hills-based financial services company, filed a $3B debt offering under Rule 506(c); $1.4B sold to 935 investors. (Amended filing.)
Bluerock Acquisition Corp. (BLRK) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement; filing cites a figure of ~$300M.
AM Sailing LP, a Grand Rapids-based company, filed an indefinite-size equity offering under Rule 506(b); $20M sold to 17 investors.
FanLabel Music Market LLC, a Birmingham-based company, filed a $2.4M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $2.4M sold to 4 investors. (Amended filing.)
Spansail Drive Apartments, LLC, an Auburn Hills-based residential real estate company, filed a $1.9M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $0 sold.

new_funds.company: Northern Shore Capital HQ Co-Invest LP
new_funds.summary: Northern Shore Capital HQ Co-Invest LP, a Bloomfield Hills-based private equity fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $0 sold.

notable_ma.summary: High Street Holdco, LLC, a Traverse City-based company, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $450K of equity issued to 1 investor.
Gilde Healthcare Holding B.V. and others reported a 10.7% stake in Shoulder Innovations, Inc. (SI) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 1).
Huang Ximing reported a 65.6% stake in Sharing Economy International Inc. (SEII).
Johnny Chen reported a 11.5% stake in Sharing Economy International Inc. (SEII).
Sharing Economy International Inc. (SEII) reported completing an acquisition or disposition of assets.
Bluerock Acquisition Corp. (BLRK) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement; filing cites a figure of ~$300M.

material_agreements.summary: UWM Holdings Corp (UWMC) entered into a material definitive agreement (equity financing).

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $1.4B sold across 8 Form D filings this week, up 2459% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Mercedes-Benz Financial Services USA LLC (Farmington Hills, Other Banking and Financial Services) targeting $3B. Good question to ask: are founders in financial services favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

Bluerock Acquisition Corp. (BLRK) disclosed a deal. It was one of 3 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan financial services assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

1 Michigan-based pooled fund filed Form Ds, reporting $0 raised so far — led by Northern Shore Capital HQ Co-Invest LP (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
